notes.title: Growing Giants - June '23 update
notes.content:
Growing Giants! We still call them as SPIDERs 
Extending the spider attack difficulty

With growing giants, the game is more interesting in its player vs spider attack sequences.
It's getting tougher to battle around in the island, while unlocking the treasures.

Further to it, the Giants are capable now to grab the treasure from the player, before it's been restored at Sanctum Chest. At the same time, the player can bring up illusioned Sanctum Pillars to entangle the Giants, which are trying to grab the treasure.

The sky is no more only blue.. It wears mysterious shade to experience a new level of gameplay going through day and night scene. It's a beautiful environment to chase your target with improved lighting in the island.

The Spider AI chasing the player character is made more reliable and at the end, the Spiders are retained in the prison across sessions of the game.

The UI messages are enhanced with visual effects and treasure icon adds up to show unlocked treasure by the player.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aHhx5gcR8IU

notes.title: Win Steam Points 5000
notes.content:
Roxroria Game team is happy to announce that top scorer of the game will Win Steam Points 5000 

The result will be announced on 1st May 2023 with player NICK NAME entered on the game settings.
Player shall share his/her Top Score and other game play screenshot(s) on the community link mentioned below to win Steam Points as AWARD(s) https://steamcommunity.com/app/2256290/screenshots/

The Roxroria Game is based on an attempt to improve certain cognitive functions for young minds!


 Pattern identification and isolation in the form of puzzle
 Hide and seek objects
 Attention in a disturbing environment
 Short term memory exercise


The Roxroria Game features, that are included in the installer package are as follows:


 Open-world exploration: Players can explore a luster green mysterious island surrounded by rock mountains and ocean. Discover its secrets and uncover hidden golden treasures.
 Puzzle-solving: The game features puzzles based on pool balls called “Odd One Out”, that players need to solve in order to progress and discover more of the island’s secrets.
 Interaction with NPCs: Players can interact with AI enabled Spider characters on the island.
 Crafting and survival mechanics: Players need to break Spider eggs in order to manage their health and attack the AI enabled Spiders using weapons to survive on the island.
 Selectable equipment: Players can switch among available weapons to help them on their quest for treasure.
 Beautiful graphics and sound design: The game features stunning visuals and a captivating soundtrack.


Playing adventure and puzzle games like Roxroria in general can potentially provide several benefits, including:


 Enhancing problem-solving skills: Adventure and puzzle games like Roxroria often require players to solve complex problems and puzzles in order to progress, which can help improve their problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
 Improving spatial reasoning: Games that involve exploration and navigation can help improve spatial reasoning skills, which is the ability to visualize and manipulate objects in space.
 Developing attention to detail: Games that require players to search for clues and hidden items can help improve attention to detail and observation skills.
 Reducing stress: Playing games can be a relaxing and enjoyable activity, which can help reduce stress and promote a positive mood.
 Encouraging creativity: Adventure games like Roxroria often allow players to approach challenges in different ways, which can encourage creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.


Have Fun!

Note : This event is extended upto to end of April 2023 for more player participation, earlier it was by end of Feb/Mar 2023.
